say:2:1541116001:1.text: Food's running low in Halia. Even I don't have enough to offer you a proper meal.
say:2:1541116001:1.source_cn: 如今呼临食物紧缺，即便是我，也没有足够的食物招待你们。

say:3:1541116002:1.text: Don't worry about it. It's not your fault.
say:3:1541116002:1.source_cn: 无需在意，这绝非你们的过错。

say:4:1541116003:1.text: Still, it's a shame we didn't get to try the famous Halian leafcakes.
say:4:1541116003:1.source_cn: 只是，没能品尝到远近闻名的呼临叶饼，的确令人遗憾。

choice_prompt:5:1541116003.text: Still, it's a shame we didn't get to try the famous Halian leafcakes.
choice_prompt:5:1541116003.source_cn: 只是，没能品尝到远近闻名的呼临叶饼，的确令人遗憾。

say:6:1541116004:1.text: They're a local specialty. Around these parts, the only thing more well-known is the wheat from Tuttleton.
say:6:1541116004:1.source_cn: 叶饼是呼临的特产。在周围所有城邦里，最出名的除了图塔镇...

say:7:1541116005:1.text: Don't let the name fool you. They've got nothing to do with tree leaves, despite what many think.
say:7:1541116005:1.source_cn: 别听它名叫叶饼，但其实，和很多人以为的树叶没有关系。

say:8:1541116006:1.text: They're just dough mixed with pulp and juice from crushed vegetables. They only call it a "leafcake" because of the leaf-like shape.
say:8:1541116006:1.source_cn: 实际上，叶饼是用许多种绿色蔬菜碾碎后的残渣和汁液，混进...

say:9:1541116007:1.text: They're incredibly sweet, with a rich aroma. Just walking past a stall selling them, you'd smell the mix of vegetables and baked barley loaves...
say:9:1541116007:1.source_cn: 叶饼的味道非常甜，而且气味浓郁。即使只是路过售卖叶饼的...

say:10:1541116008:1.text: But now? Forget vegetables and wheat. Halia can't even grow a single weed.
say:10:1541116008:1.source_cn: 可是现在……别说蔬菜和小麦，呼临已经连一根野草都种不出来了。

say:11:1541116009:1.text: I still remember my childhood... catching bugs in the fields, sowing wheat seeds. Feels like a dream now.
say:11:1541116009:1.source_cn: 回想我的童年，在田里捉虫、播撒麦种……仿佛梦一样。

choice_prompt:12:1541116009.text: I still remember my childhood... catching bugs in the fields, sowing wheat seeds. Feels like a dream now.
choice_prompt:12:1541116009.source_cn: 回想我的童年，在田里捉虫、播撒麦种……仿佛梦一样。

say:13:1541116010:1.text: It was. One of the best I have.
say:13:1541116010:1.source_cn: 没错。那是我心中最美好的记忆。

say:14:1541116011:1.text: Believe me, Perseus. Once the fallen god's curse is gone, Halia will return to what it was meant to be.
say:14:1541116011:1.source_cn: 请相信我，珀尔修斯。清除堕神诅咒之后，呼临将恢复它原本...

say:15:1541116012:1.text: Its glory, its beauty—everything it once stood for—will return.
say:15:1541116012:1.source_cn: 它曾拥有的光辉和美名，都将再度伴随它。

say:17:1541116014:1.text: It might look like a dead city now, smothered in misery. But one day, it'll wake up again.
say:17:1541116014:1.source_cn: 尽管你们眼前的呼临已荒芜不堪，几乎被苦难蒙尘。但总有一...

say:18:1541116015:1.text: And I'll stand watch until that day comes... or until I die.
say:18:1541116015:1.source_cn: 我会守卫它，直至它醒来……或是直到我死去。

say:19:1541116016:1.text: I made that promise when I was just a kid. Swore it to Master Bakis, and to the Regulus before me.
say:19:1541116016:1.source_cn: 这是我在童年时，就曾向比博老师、向先领主许下的诺言。

choice:12:1:2.text: I'm sorry it had to end that way.
choice:12:1:2.male: I'm sorry it had to end that way.
choice:12:1:2.female: I'm sorry it had to end that way.
